blogs.title: Why FlashAttention‑3 is a Game‑Changer for Long‑Context AI
blogs.description: An accessible overview of how FlashAttention‑3 turns the attention bottleneck into a fast, low‑latency operation. It explains the real‑world impact on long‑document generation, code reasoning, and multimodal models, and shows concrete speed‑up numbers in everyday language.

blogs.title: Merging GPU Memory and Computation: The Clever Tricks Behind FlashAttention‑3
blogs.description: A deep dive into the core GPU hardware concepts—Tensor Cores, Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), and warp‑specialization—that FlashAttention‑3 leverages. The post breaks down why moving data out of global memory and fusing steps makes attention so much faster, using simple diagrams and analogies.

blogs.title: From FP16 to FP8: How FlashAttention‑3 Keeps Accuracy While Cutting Compute
blogs.description: An explanation of why lower precision (FP8) hurts accuracy, what block quantization and incoherent processing are, and how FlashAttention‑3 keeps numerical error low. Readers get practical tips on when to choose FP16 vs. FP8 for inference.

blogs.title: Warp‑Specialized Pipelines: Overlapping Softmax and Matrix Multiplications
blogs.description: A step‑by‑step guide to the 2‑stage pipelining logic that lets one set of warps compute softmax while another computes the next GEMM. The blog visualizes the “ping‑pong” scheduling and shows how this reduces idle time on modern GPUs.

blogs.title: FlashAttention‑3 in Action: Benchmarks You Can Trust
blogs.description: A hands‑on review of FlashAttention‑3’s performance on NVIDIA H100 GPUs with various head sizes, sequence lengths, and causal masks. It interprets figures such as TFLOPs/s, LLM inference times, and compares with cuDNN and Triton baselines.
